style_guide.tone: Plain, direct and professional. Focus on measurable business outcomes. No hype, no exclamation marks.
style_guide.tone_effective: Plain, direct and professional. Focus on measurable business outcomes. No hype, no exclamation marks.
style_guide.notes: Always write the brand as Nova& and never expand the ampersand. Refer to the company as “we”. Give concrete numbers only when sourced. Mention UAE or GCC context where relevant. Never invent client names or case studies.
style_guide.prompt_block:
HOUSE STYLE (the customer's own style guide — follow it exactly)
- Write the business name exactly as "Nova&" everywhere, including headings, the title and the meta description — never "Nova and" or "Novaand" or "Nova-and" or "Nova &" or "Nova N" or "Nova&.ai".
- The registered legal name is "Novaand systems LLC". Use it only where a legal statement needs it (for example the company's legal details or terms), never in the title, a heading, the meta description or ordinary sentences, and never in brackets after "Nova&".
- Use British English spelling throughout (the style guide).
- Never use these words or phrases: "revolutionary", "game-changing", "cutting-edge", "unlock", "seamless", "supercharge", "leverage", "synergy", "world-class", "best-in-class", "delve", "in today’s fast-paced world".
- Tone: Plain, direct and professional. Focus on measurable business outcomes. No hype, no exclamation marks..
- Always write the brand as Nova& and never expand the ampersand. Refer to the company as “we”. Give concrete numbers only when sourced. Mention UAE or GCC context where relevant. Never invent client names or case studies.
